location_note: Railway track along the northern bank of Nahal Refa'im; printed map ref. 21540/62810-21700/62800 (a range along the track); the first point is used.
notes: Areas 100, 300, 400, 500. IBA building with a standing stone and pit L3006; eight rock-hewn pits (IBA and MB II) read by the authors as favissae; IBA shaft tomb Cave 500 reentered in Iron Age II; Ottoman watchtower. The 'En Ya'al pools and channels (Roman villa) and other tombs are cited from earlier work; not coded.
